Name: Owl Pharaoh
Notes:
(06/02/2011) (Cruis'n USA Deluxe is released)
(05/21/2013) (Owl Pharaoh is released)
Available Length: Travis Scott's breakthrough solo mixtape era following 'Cruis'n USA' Deluxe in mid-2011 through May 21, 2013. Originally planned as a free 2012 mixtape, the project missed multiple release dates and was heavily reworked as his connections with T.I., Ye, and Kid Cudi grew.

Name: Owl Pharaoh [Original Release]
Notes: Original free mixtape released on May 21, 2013 across SoundCloud and mixtape platforms. Features initial mixes of the 13-track project including 'Bandz' prior to sample clearances and streaming changes.

Name: Owl Pharaoh [iTunes Deluxe]
Notes: Mixed and mastered iTunes retail version planned for June 2013 featuring reworked tracks ('Naked' with Rick Rubin), 'Upper Echelon (Remix)', 'Bandz (Remix)', 'Home', and rumored Pharrell and Ye/Kid Cudi collaborations. Quietly cancelled before release.

Name: Days Before Rodeo [Vault 2]
Notes: Second digital deluxe copy released August 29, 2024 on travisscott.com, adding 'Hold On' and 'Respected' after the main 12-track remaster.

Name: Days Before Rodeo [Live From Atlanta]
Notes: Live album copy recorded at the 'Spotify x Cactus Jack Present Days Before Rodeo' concert in Atlanta on August 22, 2024 and released digitally on August 29, 2024.
